competing_explanations: 'none blocking another' was meant as 'no shared prerequisite', which would be a non-trivial claim not tested in S2190.
statement: Two mathematical points on S2190's measurement. (1) 'All resolvable, none blocking another' adds no evidence beyond 'in-degree 0': a node with no incoming edge cannot be reached from any other node, so distinct source nodes can never block one another. The independence of the seven roots is a tautology of the definition, not a separate finding. (2) The graph has cycles (S2201 §7: 3 cycles over 29 nodes). Reachability on it is therefore a preorder, not a partial order, and 'earliest' in meaning 1 is a minimality notion in a preorder. Leverage (number of reachable nodes) ranks roots by descendant-set size. Descendant sets can overlap (every root upstream of a cycle reaches the whole cycle), so the ranking measures reach, not precedence or disjoint influence. S2203's class-F label for leverage is consistent with this reading.
